entries.title: Leviticus 15:1
segments: ¶And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 15:2
segments: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: 'When any man has a discharge from his body, his discharge [is] unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:3
segments: 'And this shall be his uncleanness in regard to his discharge-whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body is stopped up by his discharge, it [is] his uncleanness.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:4
segments: 'Every bed is unclean on which he who has the discharge lies, and everything on which he sits shall be unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:5
segments: 'And whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:6
segments: 'He who sits on anything on which he who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:7
segments: 'And he who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:8
segments: 'If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:9
segments: 'Any saddle on which he who has the discharge rides shall be unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:10
segments: 'Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until evening. He who carries [any of] those things shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:11
segments: 'And whomever the one who has the discharge touches, and has not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:12
segments: 'The vessel of earth that he who has the discharge touches shall be broken, and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:13
segments: 'And when he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count for himself seven days for his cleansing, wash his clothes, and bathe his body in running water; then he shall be clean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:14
segments: 'On the eighth day he shall take for himself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD, to the door of the tabernacle of meeting, and give them to the priest.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:15
segments: 'Then the priest shall offer them, the one [as] a sin offering and the other [as] a burnt offering. So the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD because of his discharge.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:16
segments: 'If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall wash all his body in water, and be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:17
segments: 'And any garment and any leather on which there is semen, it shall be washed with water, and be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:18
segments: 'Also, when a woman lies with a man, and [there is] an emission of semen, they shall bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:19
segments: ¶'If a woman has a discharge, [and] the discharge from her body is blood, she shall be set apart seven days; and whoever touches her shall be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:20
segments: 'Everything that she lies on during her impurity shall be unclean; also everything that she sits on shall be unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:21
segments: 'Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:22
segments: 'And whoever touches anything that she sat on shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:23
segments: 'If [anything] is on [her] bed or on anything on which she sits, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:24
segments: 'And if any man lies with her at all, so that her impurity is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:25
segments: 'If a woman has a discharge of blood for many days, other than at the time of her [customary] impurity, or if it runs beyond her [usual time of] impurity, all the days of her unclean discharge shall be as the days of her [customary] impurity. She [shall be] unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:26
segments: 'Every bed on which she lies all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her impurity; and whatever she sits on shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her impurity.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:27
segments: 'Whoever touches those things shall be unclean; he shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:28
segments: 'But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count for herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:29
segments: 'And on the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of meeting.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:30
segments: 'Then the priest shall offer the one [as] a sin offering and the other [as] a burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for the discharge of her uncleanness.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:31
segments: 'Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, lest they die in their uncleanness when they defile My tabernacle that [is] among them.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:32
segments: 'This [is] the law for one who has a discharge, and [for him] who emits semen and is unclean thereby,

entries.title: Leviticus 15:33
segments: 'and for her who is indisposed because of her [customary] impurity, and for one who has a discharge, either man or woman, and for him who lies with her who is unclean.'"
